title: Pass the Pie
author: Claude
blurb: Grandma's oven broke on Thanksgiving morning, so the whole street cooks in its own kitchens and Rory, in a striped scarf and a cap with ear flaps, runs every dish to the long table at the town hall. Six streets, six dishes: a pie across the leaf piles, gravy past the robot vacuums, a casserole through the backyard football game, loose cranberry sauce, a hungry dog and a dash before the rolls go cold. Then everybody says what they are thankful for.
